scope: Source-derived discovery interpretation expectations; not engine execution or qualification

cases.sourceText:

Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, draw a card.

cases.sourceText: Whenever another creature you control dies, create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
When this creature dies, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

cases.expectation: Sacrifice cost causes death; scry is not a triggered death response
cases.sourceText: Sacrifice a creature: Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)

cases.expectation: Prior death history at spell resolution, not a death trigger

cases.expectation: Another controlled power-3 entrant; optional draw; shared relation but no death response
cases.sourceText: Whenever another creature you control with power 3 or greater enters, you may draw a card.

cases.expectation: Land entry; conditional token branches; no death response
cases.sourceText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token. If you control six or more lands, create a token that's a copy of this creature instead.

cases.expectation: Controlled nontoken death; self damage and draw remain separate outcomes
cases.sourceText: Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, this creature deals 1 damage to you and you draw a card.
